summary: Tested the Smart Nudge feature end-to-end on the public preview URL plus the regression items (chat filter, match filter, badge suppression). Seeded a 26h-old message from the admin user as the last message of match 5f5b1722 (script /app/backend/tests/seed_nudge_iter31.py) to trigger the nudge. Results: Smart Nudge banner in ChatPage PASS (renders above input, shows 'No reply yet — try this!', suggestion click fills the input with the exact suggestion text, dismiss hides it, nudge correctly disappears after a fresh message is sent, and correctly does NOT render in a chat whose last message is from the other user). Nudge pill on MatchesPage Messages tab PASS (exactly 1 of 2 conversation cards shows the 'Nudge' pill - the one with a 24h+ own last message and 0 unread). Chat filter strip (Recent/Oldest/Unread) PASS - all pills clickable, active style applied, order flips on Oldest. Match filter strip (Recent/Oldest/Best Match/Online) PASS - all 4 pills clickable, ordering changes. Badge suppression PASS - Likes badge absent on /likes, Chats badge absent on /matches. Backend: 4/4 pytest passed (login, matches list, message ordering, tz-aware created_at, unread-count=0).

ui_bugs.issue: nudgeDismissed is component state only - dismissing the banner is forgotten as soon as the user leaves and reopens the chat (or reloads), so the nudge reappears immediately. Consider persisting dismissal per match_id in localStorage with a cooldown.

NUDGE_ICEBREAKERS is declared inside the component body and the suggestion is picked with Math.random() inside useMemo, so the suggested icebreaker re-rolls on every messages/dismiss state change (observed suggestion swapping between renders). Move the array to module scope and derive the index deterministically (e.g., hash of matchId) so the copy is stable.

On a 390px viewport the last pill of the match filter strip ('Online') and the 'Active (0)' tab are clipped at the right edge; they are reachable only via horizontal scroll with no visible affordance (no fade/scroll hint).

issues: Contrast and spacing are fine (pink accent text on light gradient pill, adequate padding above the input)
Dismiss '✕' is a small unlabeled hit target at the top-right of the banner - consider aria-label + larger tap area

The 'Reward Claimed!' daily-reward modal (data-testid=daily-reward-modal) renders a few seconds AFTER navigation, so it can appear on top of /matches and block all clicks until dismissed. Not a functional bug but it caused a full test run to be blocked; consider showing it only on /discover or immediately after login.

action_items: Persist nudge dismissal per match (localStorage) so it does not reappear on every chat open
Make the icebreaker suggestion stable (module-scope array + deterministic index) instead of Math.random() inside useMemo
Optional: avoid the daily-reward modal appearing over /matches (delayed render blocks interaction)
critical_code_review_comments: The 24h/own-last-message rule is duplicated: ChatPage.jsx:54-65 (useMemo) and MatchesPage.jsx:752 (inline 86400000 check). Extract a shared helper (e.g. utils/nudge.js isNudgeDue(lastMessage, userId)) to keep the two views in sync.
ChatPage useMemo deps omit NUDGE_ICEBREAKERS (recreated each render) - exhaustive-deps violation and the source of the random suggestion churn.

MatchesPage nudge pill is gated on unreadCount === 0 which is correct, but ChatPage banner does not check the other user's read/typing state; harmless but worth noting for future 'they are typing' suppression.
seed_data_creation: Backdated all messages of match 5f5b1722-cc69-4e4c-bde5-f41e21ed0747 and inserted 'TEST_NUDGE_LAST_MSG hey there, are you around?' from admin (89a6e3b5...) at now-26h as the last message; all receiver_id=admin messages marked read so unreadCount=0. Re-run /app/backend/tests/seed_nudge_iter31.py (idempotent) to restore the nudge state after any new message is sent in that chat.

rca_of_the_issue: No defects in the feature itself. Only design/robustness gaps: dismissal is not persisted (component state) and the icebreaker is re-randomised on every useMemo recompute because Math.random() is called inside the memo with a component-scoped array.
